verdict.rationale: Appwrite's self-hosting docs explicitly state 'full control over data location' and that it can be installed on any Docker-capable infrastructure, letting AI-native users choose where their data resides by hosting themselves (appwrite-docs-24, appwrite-docs-14/19/33). However, there is no evidence of a managed-cloud region-selection feature (e.g., picking an AWS/GCP region in Appwrite Cloud) for users who don't want to self-host. Missing for 10: cloud region/residency selector, explicit list of supported regions for hosted Appwrite, and independent confirmation of data-residency guarantees.
